title: Solar particle storm warning
description: Archived SEP event first recorded near Earth on 6 September 2017. NASA's Curiosity rover measured the strongest solar-particle radiation increase on Mars since landing during 10–12 September 2017.
lesson: Solar particles can travel across space and raise radiation at Mars. The crew must decide whether to spend power on the Shield Generator.
source: NASA CCMC DONKI SEP; NASA/JPL Curiosity RAD report
data_note: The DONKI observation date and the later Mars surface measurement are both archived. RadLab dose-rate samples for the Mars event are stored separately in radiation.json.
